memory.help.action.review: review candidates, contests and stale entries (a person's cards)
memory.help.action.purge: delete an entry's content or a Run's entries (a person's card)
memory.review.title: Memory review in scope {scope}: {items} entries and {contests} contests to look at.
memory.review.none: Nothing to review: no candidate, contested or stale entry in this scope.
memory.review.incomplete: Only the newest entries were read; entries older than these are not on this review.
memory.review.card.title: Review this memory entry ({position} of {count})
memory.review.note.default: Reviewed on the memory review card.
memory.review.reason.default: Retired on the memory review card.
memory.review.done: Review finished: {verified} verified, {retired} retired, {purged} purged, {resolved} contests resolved, {skipped} skipped.
memory.review.stopped: Review stopped; the decisions you applied are kept.
memory.view.audience: Serves: work of family {family}, work target {target}.
memory.view.audience.scopeWide: Serves: the whole scope (a person's entry).
memory.view.support: Evidence: Run {run}, task {task}, attempt {attempt} · rule {rule}@{version} ({producer}) · evaluation {evaluation}
memory.view.tombstone: Purged ({reason}): the content is gone; only a keyed digest that blocks proposing it again is kept.
memory.view.stale: Stale: no new evidence for longer than its retention ({days} days); it is kept out of model context and waits for your retire or purge.
memory.view.contested: Contested: an evaluation found it in conflict with another entry; it is kept out of model context until you decide.
memory.purge.card.title: Purge the content of {count} memory entries? Pick the reason.
memory.purge.card.scope:
Removed: each entry's text in every revision, its search row, and the stored prompts and answers of its evaluator calls. Kept: a keyed digest that only this installation can compute, which blocks proposing the same text again, and the purge record.
Not removed: the worker output and reports the entry came from, copies already frozen into Runs' model context, existing backups (restoring one re-applies this purge before work starts), the copy the evaluator's provider received, the plain digest of each evaluator call's request kept in its call receipt, and plain digests in audit events and receipts sealed before keyed digests.
memory.purge.done: Purged {id}: {revisions} revisions now hold only the tombstone; evaluator content removed from {invocations} calls.
memory.source.none: No memory entry comes from {source} in this scope.
memory.source.incomplete: More entries come from {source} than one card holds; run the command again for the rest.
memory.source.retire.title: Retire {count} memory entries from {source}?
memory.source.retire.body: Reason: {reason}. They and their revisions stay readable; nothing is deleted.
memory.source.retired: Retired {count} entries from {source} ({skipped} were already retired).
memory.contest.card.title: Resolve this memory contest?
memory.held.next.MEMORY_PURGE_REPLAY_HEL: A memory purge recorded in the purge journal is not in the ledger yet (for example after a backup restore), so nothing is read until it is re-applied. Start the service (`deckent runtime serve`, or open `deckent terminal`), or run any memory change on your terminal: both re-apply it first. If the journal itself cannot be read, keep the installation as it is and run `deckent doctor`.
backup.restore.memoryPurges: {count} memory purges recorded after this backup will be re-applied before any work starts.
error.MEMORY_PURGE_REPLAY_HELD: A memory purge from the purge journal could not be re-applied (or the journal cannot be read); memory is held so purged content is never shown again.
error.MEMORY_PERSON_REQUIRED: Only a person can do this on their own terminal: no AI purges memory, retires it by source or resolves a contest.
error.MEMORY_CONTEST_RESOLVED: This contest was already resolved with another decision; nothing was changed.
error.MEMORY_PURGE_INVOCATION_REFUSED: The purge names a model call that is not one of this entry's own evaluator calls; nothing was deleted.
